gloss: that day, the day in question

definitions.gloss: that day, the day in question, the appointed day
definitions.explanation: The specific day being discussed or the day when an event takes place.

examples.japanese: {当日|とうじつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{晴|は}れる→晴れる：00701_hareru⟧⟦でしょう→でしょう：09887_deshou⟧。
examples.english: It will probably be sunny on that day.

examples.japanese: {当日|とうじつ}⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I will purchase a same-day ticket.

examples.japanese: {当日|とうじつ}⟦キャンセル→キャンセル：06776_kyanseru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。

notes:
FORMS:
{当|とう} (this, the relevant) + {日|じつ} (day)

USAGE:
Refers to the specific day being discussed or the day of an event. Can mean "that day" (referring to a past event) or "on the day" (same-day, as opposed to in advance).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {当日|とうじつ}⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧: same-day ticket
- {当日|とうじつ}⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧: same-day reservation
- {当日|とうじつ}⟦キャンセル→キャンセル：06776_kyanseru⟧: same-day cancellation
- ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧{当日|とうじつ}: the day of the event
- {当日|とうじつ}⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧: on-site registration

DAY SEQUENCE:
- ⟦{前日|ぜんじつ}→前日：03108_zenjitsu⟧: the day before
- {当日|とうじつ}: that day, the day of
- ⟦{翌日|よくじつ}→翌日：17960_yokujitsu⟧: the next day, the following day
